item.title: Randolph County Emergency Squad looks to close gap on $1 million budget issue
item.description: The Randolph County Emergency Squad is $1 million short of its budget and officials with the organization and the county are searching for ways to close the gap.

item.title: Pierpont Community and Technical College hosts students for aviation technology workshop
item.description: Every Friday until May 1, middle schools throughout north central West Virginia will be heading to Pierpont's Robert C. Byrd National Aerospace Education Center in Bridgeport to learn more about aviation and the maintenance that goes into keeping planes in the sky.

item.title: 30+ grams of 'suspected cocaine' found during Morgantown traffic stop; man charged
item.description: A man has been arrested and is facing charges after West Virginia State Troopers say he was found with more than 30 grams of suspected cocaine while driving with a revoked license.

item.title: 3 sent to hospital after 2 wrecks in Harrison County at the same intersection
item.description: At least three people were taken to the hospital on Thursday following two separate wrecks at the exact same intersection in Harrison County.

item.title: Gardner Winter Music Festival showcases Appalachian performances
item.description: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. - The annual Gardner Winter Music Festival returned to South Middle School in Morgantown, continuing a tradition that dates back more than four decades. Organizers said the event has been bringing traditional Appalachian music, song, and dance to the region since 1979. item.title: 6 displaced after fire damages Clarksburg home
item.description: Six people have been displaced after a fire broke out at a Clarksburg home Thursday evening.

item.title: Woman threatened to kill child with razor blade in Clarksburg, police say
item.description: A woman has been charged after allegedly threatening to kill a child with a razor blade in Clarksburg.

item.title: West Virginia Senate passes bill for medical psilocybin use
item.description: A new bill in West Virginia aims to legalize the prescription use of psilocybin, the active compound in magic mushrooms, for medical purposes.

item.title: Fairmont building a 'total loss' after evening fire
item.description: According to a Facebook post by the Fairmont Fire Department, emergency crews were alerted to a commercial building fire at the corner of Pennsylvania Avenue and Grafton Street at roughly 8:53 p.m. on Thursday.

item.title: SWAT Team raid in Harrison County nets nearly 60 grams of fentanyl; 2 arrested
item.description: Two people have been arrested in Harrison County after multiple agencies, including the SWAT Team, executed a search warrant early Friday morning that yielded significant amounts of methamphetamine and fentanyl.
